description: Guard for the Glowming campaign files: guard.js checks every write, shell command and connector call against an allow-list using the files on disk; calendar-links.js puts the posting calendar back if a save lost a tracking link; a content-only check reads the text being written.

hooks.prompt:
Below is the JSON input of a file-writing tool call. Judge ONLY the new text it would put into the file: the fields tool_input.content, tool_input.new_string, tool_input.edits[].new_string and tool_input.new_source. IGNORE every other field completely, including session_id, transcript_path, cwd, hook_event_name, tool_name, tool_input.file_path, tool_input.notebook_path and tool_input.old_string: those are system data, not text being written, and a path or id there is never a reason to block.

$ARGUMENTS

BLOCK if the new text contains any of: a password, API key, token, card or bank number, or ID number; a cost price, landed cost, margin or internal funding split; another company's or client's private business that is not Glowming; a computer file path such as C:/Users/.... Do NOT judge health, weight-loss or benefit claims: those are checked by a separate code guard against Anton's recorded approvals (owner ruling 2026-10-01), so a claim is never a reason for you to block. Shell commands and connector calls are handled by that guard too; judge only this text. ALLOW everything else. If you block, say in one plain sentence what to remove or what source is needed.
